answer: Proof of Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions. An attacker must acquire a sable-colored mountain of tokens, creating a cost that scales linearly with influence. This mechanism mimics a vine of economic dependency, where every node is anchored to the network like a ship in a deep lagoon. The cost for an adversary to dominate the validator set is prohibitively high, as it demands a majority stake that renders the attack self-destructive.
